goals.title: Establish Goal Tracking OS
goals.description: Create structured goals, roadmap links, evidence, execution records, review templates, and validator checks.

goals.validation_method: npm run check:goal-tracking and npm run check:seis-goal-tracking-update-prompt validate source records, the bounded prompt package, proposal schema, evidence, and execution records.

notes: User-approved bounded Goal Tracking Update Orchestrator prompt package added on 2026-07-14.
The five-million-character request is modeled as an aggregate context ceiling; no filler, live provider claim, or automatic completion claim is allowed.
